dedupe_keys.name: sint maarten open gis data portal and vromi gis viewer ministry of public housing spatial planning environment and infrastructure

description: The Sint Maarten Open GIS Data Portal is where the Government of Sint Maarten, through its ministry for public housing, spatial planning, environment and infrastructure (VROMI), shares spatial datasets about the country. The portal read on 2026-09-28 says datasets can be downloaded as ESRI shapefiles, spreadsheets, KML or through an API, that anybody is free to use the data for commercial or non-commercial purposes (with a footnoted condition), and that the VROMI GIS Viewer web app shows the government's spatial data on any device; data are grouped into categories including boundaries, buildings, elevation, environment, history, infrastructure and water. Coverage is Sint Maarten (the Dutch side of the island). Access is free download. Caveats: the portal's public search service returned no dataset items from the cloud session, so the layer list could not be counted, and the footnoted terms were not read. It supports hazard exposure studies of buildings and infrastructure on a hurricane-exposed island, such as after Hurricane Irma. Related record: the Sint Maarten 2011 census housing publication complements the building layers.
